department: Department of Biostatistics and Computational Biology (School of Medicine and Dentistry)

deadline.value: Apply by December 15, 2026 to be considered for full funding; review starts December 1. Applying by November 15 waives the fee.
deadline.quote: Applicants must submit their portion of the application by December 15.

also.quote: PhD Statistics - Review of applications will begin on December 1, 2026; however, applications will be accepted until December 15, 2026

app_fee.value: USD 60, automatically waived if you submit by November 15.
app_fee.quote: If you are applying after November 15 and the $60 application fee would create an undue hardship

fee_waiver.value: The fee is automatically waived for all PhD Statistics applications submitted by November 15, 2026; later hardship waivers by email.
fee_waiver.quote: The application fee is automatically waived for all PhD Statistics applications submitted by November 15.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not looked at, even if submitted.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are no longer used by the Admissions Committee in evaluating applications to the program.

gre_subject.value: GRE scores of any kind are not looked at.
gre_subject.quote: GRE scores are no longer used by the Admissions Committee in evaluating applications to the program.

toefl_min.value: No strict score criteria; the application is judged as a whole.
toefl_min.quote: Rather than using strict criteria with respect to course grades and language proficiency scores (e.g., TOEFL, IELTS, DuoLingo English), we consider each application as a whole

ielts_min.value: No strict score criteria; the application is judged as a whole.
ielts_min.quote: Rather than using strict criteria with respect to course grades and language proficiency scores (e.g., TOEFL, IELTS, DuoLingo English), we consider each application as a whole

english_waiver.value: Manual waiver review for a bachelor's from a country where English is an official language and all instruction is in English, with at least six full semesters in good standing; India's eligibility is not stated, so ask the department.
english_waiver.quote: from a country where English is an official language and all instruction is provided in English (manual waiver review). A minimum of six full semesters of academic coursework in good standing is required to qualify for a waiver

supervisor.value: Students are admitted to the program as a whole; mentors are chosen in years 2-3.
supervisor.quote: Students are admitted to the PhD program as a whole, rather than to directly work with individual professors.

funding.value: Every admitted PhD student gets full tuition, health insurance and a stipend, regardless of citizenship.
funding.quote: All admitted PhD Statistics students receive a generous funding package that includes a full tuition scholarship, health insurance for single individual coverage, and a competitive 10-month stipend. | Funding is offered to every PhD student who is accepted into the program

entry_route.value: A master's is not needed; the equivalent of a US bachelor's degree is enough.
entry_route.quote: No, only the equivalent of a U.S. baccalaureate degree from a college, university, or technical school of acceptable standing is required.

notes: The School of Medicine and Dentistry runs this program with its own application, so its fee, GRE and English rules replace the Arts and Sciences/Hajim ones.
